name: Running Away From God
overview: The Scriptures reveal that attempting to flee from God's presence is futile, as His Spirit is everywhere and cannot be escaped (Psalms 139:7). While the heart is deceitful and prone to wickedness (Jeremiah 17:9), God calls His people to trust Him even in darkness and to obey His voice (Isaiah 50:10). Those who forsake the Lord, the source of living waters, will face shame and judgment (Jeremiah 17:13). Yet, as seen in Jonah's prayer from the depths of despair, turning back to God in repentance is always possible (Jonah 2:1), and God promises to enlarge the hearts of those who run in the way of His commandments (Psalms 119:32).
